title: Claude Code Profiles
description: Schema for claude-code-profiles.json — defines named profiles for model selection, API endpoint, and auth.

notes.description: Usage notes about how profiles work

profiles.description: Named profiles. Each profile inherits from 'default' (except 'bare' which is standalone).

sandbox_image.description: Docker image used for sandboxed execution (when --sandbox is passed). Inherits from 'default' if not set on a child profile.

env.description: Environment variables set by this profile — applied in both native and sandbox modes

sandbox.description: Sandbox-mode overrides. env here merges on top of the base env when --sandbox is used.

env.description: Environment variables applied only in sandbox mode (overrides base env)

local.description: Local-mode overrides. env here merges on top of the base env when running natively.

env.description: Environment variables applied only in local/native mode (overrides base env)
